premises.text: Traptic's robots automate the strawberry harvesting process
premises.evidence_span: Traptic's giant farming robots pick strawberries.

premises.text: The robotic platform can detect and reach berries using a vision system
premises.evidence_span: our vision system detects the berries and figures out how to reach them.

premises.text: The patented gripper can delicately extract produce from plants
premises.evidence_span: our patented gripper delicately extracts the produce from the plant.

premises.text: The system operates effectively in various environmental conditions
premises.evidence_span: It is robust to dust, dirt, rain, wind, vibrations, and the other aspects of the tough farm environment.

premises.text: The gripper can handle objects of varying size and shape without needing additional information
premises.evidence_span: This gives the gripper mechanical compliance, allowing it to grab objects of varying size and shape without needing any information about the object's properties.

premises.text: Traptic's robot can find berries and determine ripeness with accuracy comparable to humans

premises.text: Traptic focuses on year-round strawberry harvesting without requiring changes in growing processes
premises.evidence_span: We don't require any change in growing process, providing a smooth path for deployment.

premises.text: The business model is based on a pay-per-pound service for strawberry harvesting
premises.evidence_span: growers will pay us 23 cents per pound.

premises.text: Traptic has developed testing partnerships with major commercial growers
